provenance.sourceName: TDK Corporation, Mn-Zn Ferrite Material characteristics (May 2022, file stamp 20220510)
provenance.verificationMethod: Per grade, 'Typ.' values: table 'Mn-Zn Material list of large size ferrite for high power' (p.14/24) and the PC40 material page (p.17/24), row PC40, column 'Thermal conductivity* (W/mK)' prints 5 and column 'Specific heat* Cp (J/kg•K)' prints 800; no temperature stated for either column. Replaces the 1-5 W/mK family value from TDK's Ferrite Summary (December 2021). TDK's current edition (ferrite_material_characteristics_en.pdf, April 2026) no longer prints a thermal-conductivity column; the May 2022 edition was read through a browser session because product.tdk.com refuses plain HTTP clients.

provenance.derivation: Steinmetz power law with a parabolic temperature factor, least-squares fit to the manufacturer's loss points of this material, temperature factor 1 at 25 C, ranges spanning the measured frequencies, the upper range held continuous with the lower one at their shared frequency
